InvestmentTarget.title: InvestmentTarget
InvestmentTarget.description: A saved USD-to-PKR investment plan configuration belonging to a signed-in user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this target.

title.description: Descriptive label for the investment target plan.

holdingDays.description: Holding duration in calendar days (1 to 365).

spreadPkr.description: Open-market dealer spread in PKR per USD (0 to 25).

targetProfitMode.description: Whether Target Profit Mode is enabled.

targetProfitPkr.description: Desired net profit in PKR when Target Profit Mode is active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the target was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the target was last updated.

/investmentTargets/{targetId}.description: Top-level collection storing user-owned USD-to-PKR investment target plans.
